bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
BR='integrate/profile-menu-merge-online-20261108'
EXPECTED='580730cb1b53a664c332859a5a8c9a1004ace29a'
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = "$BR" || exit 82
for p in artifacts/bot/src/services/dmBareStartPostingMenu.ts artifacts/bot/src/gaybbsBot.ts artifacts/bot/src/services/topicDmEntry.ts artifacts/bot/src/bot/recruitmentHandlers.ts artifacts/bot/src/bot/profileHandlers.ts artifacts/bot/tests; do
 git diff --quiet -- "$p" || exit 84
 git diff --cached --quiet -- "$p" || exit 84
 test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- "$p")" || exit 84
done
git fetch --no-tags origin "refs/heads/$BR:refs/remotes/origin/$BR"
test "$(git rev-parse "refs/remotes/origin/$BR")" = "$EXPECTED" || exit 85
git merge --ff-only "refs/remotes/origin/$BR" || exit 86
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED" || exit 87
printf 'SOURCE_SYNC=PASS\n'
